_readme: Kashkoul text used by the theme's own sections, in English and Arabic — from docs/market/content.md. Run `node market/tools/sync-strings.mjs` after editing; it copies each language into theme/locales/ (en.default.json, ar.json) under the "kashkoul" key. Section settings left empty in the theme editor show this text; a setting the owner fills in wins. "shopify_overrides" holds our wording for some of Shopify's own checkout text (contact field labels), written under the "shopify" key.

how_to_order.title: How to order
how_to_order.intro: Three steps, and you never need a card. Order here, we confirm on WhatsApp, and you pay when it arrives.
how_to_order.step_1_text: Add what you need to your cart, check out, and leave a phone number we can reach on WhatsApp.
how_to_order.step_2_text: We message you to confirm the items, the price and the delivery day.
how_to_order.step_3_text: In cash or with Whish. Or pick up your order free from Kashkoul in Khaldeh.

delivery_pickup.title: Delivery & pickup
delivery_pickup.intro: We deliver anywhere in Lebanon for one flat fee, or you pick up your order free from Kashkoul in Khaldeh.
delivery_pickup.delivery_text: We confirm the delivery day with you on WhatsApp. From time to time we run free-delivery offers; they're shown at the top of the site.
delivery_pickup.pickup_text: Mon–Sat, 12pm–8pm · Sundays by appointment. We'll tell you when your order is ready.

returns.title: Returns
returns.intro: If something arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, we'll make it right.
returns.window_text: to tell us, from the moment you receive your order.
returns.case_1_text: Broken, scratched or not working when it reached you.
returns.case_2_text: A different item, size, color or version from your order.
returns.case_result: We'll exchange it or refund you, in cash or by Whish.
returns.step_1_text: Within {{ hours }} hours of receiving it, with a photo of the item.
returns.step_2_text: We answer the same day and agree with you on an exchange or a refund.
returns.step_3_text: We swap the item, or refund you in cash or by Whish.
returns.not_covered_text: We can't take back items because of a change of mind, since most are ordered from the US especially for you.
returns.warranty_text: We don't offer a warranty beyond this {{ hours }}-hour check, so please look your order over when it arrives.
